bios.label: Short Bio (~110 words)
bios.content: Marlon Avery is Founder & CEO / Chief AI Officer of VoicePath, an AI agency specializing in HIPAA-compliant voice solutions, and serves as VP, Applied AI Lead at JPMorgan Chase. With 10+ years in Generative AI, he has built tools like the AI Receptionist (integrated with Veradigm EHR) — improving patient communication response times by 60% and cutting customer-service costs up to 40%. As Head of AI & CEO of AImpact, he has been contracted by Microsoft to lead Azure OpenAI bootcamps and commissioned by Google + Dream Machine for the AI Library Project tour. He has trained 10,000+ professionals across 80+ workshops and granted 10,000+ Pledge to Equality scholarships.

topics.title: Voice AI in Production

topics.abstract: Lessons from delivering 80+ AImpact workshops to 10,000+ professionals — including Microsoft Azure OpenAI bootcamps and the Google + Dream Machine AI Library Project tour.
